name: Static Shock
description: An ordinary inner-city kid gains extraordinary powers and becomes an urban legend as the first teenage African-American superhero.

videos.title: Shock to the System
videos.overview: Virgil gains powers after being exposed to a strange gas that leaks from its cannister when it's hit by a bullet during a gang gunfight.

videos.title: Aftershock
videos.overview: F-Stop, Virgil's teen-gang nemesis, gains his own superpowers and calls himself "Hotstreak." Meanwhile, Virgil learns who's responsible for the gas that gave him and F-Stop their powers.

videos.title: The Breed
videos.overview: A track athlete Virgil's tutoring mutates into a metahuman and joins Ebon's criminal gang known as the "Metabreed."

videos.title: Grounded
videos.overview: Virgil and Richie vs. a people-eating amoeba that's running amok in the high school late at night and threatening the school-newspaper staff.

videos.title: They're Playing My Song
videos.overview: Rubberband Man goes after the rapper he says stole his music, and Static gets caught in the middle. Meanwhile, Virgil gets a job at a burger joint.

videos.title: The New Kid
videos.overview: Virgil transfers to a school for advanced students, where he works on an electricity-absorbing prototype. Trouble is, the school turns out to be funded by Edwin Alva, and the prototype is used to make a robot that Alva wants for his nefarious ends.

videos.title: Child's Play
videos.overview: A bad boy learns that his younger stepbrother is metahuman, and wants him to use his powers to steal things.

videos.title: Sons of the Fathers
videos.overview: Richie's captured by Ebon after running away from home because of his father's racist attitude toward Virgil.

videos.title: Winds of Change
videos.overview: A bang baby who can control the wind emerges, calls himself Slipsteam and begins to cause trouble in Dakota. Meanwhile, Richie and Virgil get into a fight over Richie's newest crime-fighting invention, the ZapCap.

videos.title: Bent Out of Shape
videos.overview: Sharon dates a rapper who turns out to be Rubberband Man, who has escaped from prison. Static isn't pleased and that's not all Rubberband Man has to worry about: two metahuman bounty hunters are on his trail.

videos.title: Junior
videos.overview: Edwin Alva vs. his son, who's tired of being ignored and dismissed by his father. So Junior, who has figured out how to control the metahuman serum, uses it to become one himself--Omnifarious--and takes on his dad.

videos.title: Replay
videos.overview: A washed-up child actor with meta-human powers clones Static, and the clone goes on a crime spree.

videos.title: Tantrum
videos.overview: A purple metahuman goes on a rampage at school, and Virgil and Richie think they know who it is: an honor student whose grades were less than perfect.

videos.title: The Big Leagues
videos.overview: Virgil gets help from Batman and Robin to battle The Joker and thwart the Gotham City bigwig's efforts to recruit thugs from Dakota to carry on his mayhem.

videos.title: Power Play
videos.overview: Richie gets temporary superpowers, and really likes using them. Perhaps too much.

videos.title: Brother-Sister Act
videos.overview: Sharon suspects that her brother Virgil is Static, and she tries to prove it as Static battles brother-sister metahuman duo Mirage and Boom.

videos.title: Static Shaq
videos.overview: Shaquille O'Neal assists Static as he goes after a gang of ruffians known as the Ruffpack.

videos.title: Frozen Out
videos.overview: At Christmastime, Static must stop the icy antics of a homeless metahuman named Permafrost.

videos.title: Sunspots
videos.overview: Sunspots cause Static's powers to increase exponentially, then he loses them altogether, which Hotstreak, who has just been released from jail, soon discovers.

videos.title: Pop's Girlfriend
videos.overview: Virgil refuses to cooperate with a police officer attempting to search his backpack, because he doesn't want her to find his Static suit. It turns out that this cop is his dad's new girlfriend, and that she was looking for a briefcase stolen by two boys who are also making meta-gas.

videos.title: Bad Stretch
videos.overview: Rubberband Man returns and saves Static from a new villain named Aquamaria, but it'll take more than that to get Static to believe that Rubberband Man is now a good guy.

videos.title: Attack of the Living Brain Puppets
videos.overview: A Bang Baby named Madelyn Spaulding turns everyone in Dakota into a zombie. Everyone but Virgil, that is.

videos.title: Duped
videos.overview: Adam Evans (the Rubberband-Man) gets a recording contract with the help of A.J. McLean of the Backstreet Boys, but the jealous shape-shifter Replikon kidnaps A.J. in an attempt to scuttle Adam's deal.

videos.title: Jimmy
videos.overview: Virgil and Richie befriend shy classmate Jimmy Osgood, who is the focus of a school bully.

videos.title: Hard as Nails
videos.overview: Static travels to Gotham City to rescue Nails, a school friend of his who is now associating with Harley and Ivy, who promise to cure Nails of her Bang Baby affliction.

videos.title: Gear
videos.overview: Richie's newfound supersmartness leads to him becoming a superhero in his own right and Static's latest partner.

videos.title: Static in Africa
videos.overview: While visiting Africa as his secret identity, Static teams up with an African superhero, Anansi, to defeat the villain Osebo, before he blows up a dam.

videos.title: Shebang
videos.overview: Static encounters a sassy, female teenage superhero, Shebang, who outperforms him every time they meet.

videos.title: The Usual Suspect
videos.overview: Virgil inadvertently makes an enemy out of a school tough guy when he mistakenly believes the bully to be Dakota's latest meta human monster.

videos.title: A League of Their Own (1)
videos.overview: Static and Gear are alone in the Justice League's headquarters when Brainiac takes it over.

videos.title: A League of Their Own (2)
videos.overview: Back on Earth, Static discovers that Brainiac has taken over Gear through Backpack. Static needs the help of the Justice League to save his friend.

videos.title: Showtime
videos.overview: Static becomes the star of a reality television show.

videos.title: Consequences
videos.overview: Virgil begins to act arrogant and boastful. While battling with Puff and Onyx, Static tries to impress Daisy with his amazing ways, but she is hurt during the fight.

videos.title: Romeo in the Mix
videos.overview: Lil' Romeo joins forces with Static to defeat the Leech, a metahuman who is stealing other metahumans' powers.

videos.title: Trouble Squared
videos.overview: Armed with new gadgets and powers, Specs and Trapper try to impress their boss, Alva, by capturing Static.

videos.title: Toys in the Hood
videos.overview: Static teams up with Superman when the Man of Steel's old nemesis Toyman appears in Dakota.

videos.title: The Parent Trap
videos.overview: Shebang returns to Dakota to enlist Static and Gear's help when her parents go missing and are feared kidnapped.

videos.title: Flashback
videos.overview: When Static becomes involved with a meta-human who can manipulate time and space, Static is thrown back in time and encounters his mother.

videos.title: Blast from the Past
videos.overview: Static teams up with a retired superhero when the old crimefighter's nemesis comes back to threaten the town of Dakota.

videos.title: Future Shock
videos.overview: Static must save his future self when he's accidentally transported 40 years into the future.

videos.title: She-Back!
videos.overview: She-Bang returns, to Static and Gear's annoyance. More threatening to Static is Madelyn Spaulding, who breaks some meta-humans out of jail and sends them after him.

videos.title: Out of Africa
videos.overview: Anasi must keep the golden spider that's the source of super powers away from Osebo. The spider has turned up in Dakota.

videos.title: Fallen Hero
videos.overview: Static vs. Green Lantern. This is a pity because Green Lantern has long been a hero of Static's, but robberies have been committed and all signs point to Green Lantern.

videos.title: Army of Darkness
videos.overview: Static and Gear fight Nightbreed, a meta-human gang whose members can't live in sunlight, so they're setting out to take it away from everyone else.

videos.title: No Man's an Island
videos.overview: Edwin Alva captures Static and Hotstreak for scientific experiments and handcuffs them together. So they must work together if they're going to escape. Trouble is, they can't stand each other.

videos.title: Hoop Squad
videos.overview: Static and a group of NBA stars moonlighting as superheroes team up to rescue Gear, who was been kidnapped by the evil scientist Dr. Odium.

videos.title: Now You See Him ...
videos.overview: A teen thief named Speedwarp who can manipulate time wants to romance Daisy, but Static and Gear think that's a bad idea.

videos.title: Where the Rubber Meets the Road
videos.overview: Rubberband Man must overcome his dyslexia to help Static and Gear disarm a fusion reactor stolen from Edwin Alva's lab as part of a "disaster matrix" plan hatched by Specs and Trapper to wreak havoc in the city.

videos.title: Linked
videos.overview: A pro-football player hides the fact that he's a Bang Baby.

videos.title: Wet and Wild
videos.overview: Aquamaria is cured of "Bang Baby syndrome"--until Hotstreak un-cures her, and her resulting rampage could mean total chaos in Dakota City.

videos.title: Kidnapped
videos.overview: Static's dad is kidnapped by Omnara, a scientist who once worked for Alva and who now wants to raid Alva's labs in an effort to control world technology.

videos.title: Power Outage
videos.overview: all the Bang Babies--Static and Gear included--begin to lose their powers, thanks to Dr. Donald Todd.

country: United States, China, Philippines, South Korea, Japan
